verses.text: Ix schekan winhaj rey David b'ochajk'e juntzanh pat t'a jun chonhab' skuch Schonhab' winhaj David. Ix sik'anel jun lugar winh b'aj tz'aj te' skaxa'il strato Dios t'a yol jun mantiado ix b'ochaji.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha heb' manh levita'ok, max yal yik'anb'ey te' skaxa'il trato heb', yujto ha Jehová ix sik'anel heb' levita chi' yik syik'an b'ey te' kaxa chi' heb', yik tz'ak'jipax serwil yuj heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yawtejkot masanil heb' yetisraelal winh, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' t'a Jerusalén, yik sb'at ik'chajkot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová yik tz'ochkan te' t'a jun lugar b'ob'ilxo yuj winh.
Ix smolb'an pax masanil heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' levita.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat, 120 heb' ix molchaji, ha winhaj Uriel yajal yaj t'a heb' sk'ab'yok.
Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, 220 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Asaías yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, 130 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Joel yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Elizafán, 200 heb' ix molchaji: Ha winhaj Semaías yajal yaj t'a heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón, 80 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Eliel yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Uziel, 112 heb' ix molchaji, ha winhaj Aminadab yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.

Ix yawtan heb' winh sacerdote winhaj rey David chi', haton winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Abiatar yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh levita, haton winhaj Uriel, winhaj Asaías, winhaj Joel, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Eliel yet' winhaj Aminadab.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha hex levita hex tik, yajal heyaj t'a skal masanil heb' he k'ab' heyok, b'o'ek he b'a icha yalan ley yet' masanil heb' he k'ab' heyok, yik syal heyik'ankot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová ko Diosal, yik tz'ochkan te' t'a jun lugar b'ob'il wu'uj.
Yujto ha t'a sb'ab'elal, manhok hex ix heyik'kot te', yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová ko Diosal t'a kib'anh, yujto manh chamok ix ko k'anb'ej kab'i tas sko k'ulej, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix sakb'itan sb'a heb' winh icha yalan ley, yik wach' syal yik'ankot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová sDiosal Israel chi' heb' winh.
Ix sb'akhankot te' heb' winh t'a sjolom sjenhjab' yet' te' sb'akhlab'il, icha ajnak yalankan winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová.

Ix yalanpax winhaj rey David chi' t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' levita to ha t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh chi', sik'chajelta heb' winh sb'itan t'a tzalajk'olal yet' juntzanh yamk'ab', haton salterio, arpa yet' platillo.

Yuj chi' ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal Leví chi' ix sik'chajel heb' winh stzinhan platillo, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Hemán yuninal winhaj Joel yet' winhaj Asaf yuninal winhaj Berequías sk'ab'yok winhaj Hemán chi' yet' winhaj Etán yuninal winhaj Cusaías. Ha heb' winh tik yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Merari. Ix sik'chajpaxoch juntzanhxo heb' winh tz'ak'an te' arpa: Haton winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Jaaziel, winhaj Semiramot, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Uni, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Maaseías, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Elifelehu, winhaj Micnías yet' heb' winh stanhwan puerta, haton winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jeiel.
Haxo winhaj Quenanías yajalil heb' winh levita chi'. Ha winh skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi', yujto te jelan winh.

Haxo heb' winh stanhwan te' skaxa'il trato: Haton winhaj Berequías, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jehías. Haxo heb' winh sacerdote: Haton winhaj Sebanías, winhaj Josafat, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Amasías, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Eliezer. Haton heb' winh spu'an trompeta t'a yichanh te' skaxa'il strato Dios chi'.

Ha winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado, te tzalajk'olal yaj heb' ayik ix xit' yik'an te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi' heb' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom chi'.
Ix och wal Dios yet' heb' levita chi' ayik ix yik'ankot te' kaxa chi' heb', yuj chi' ix yak' ukwanh nok' mam wakax heb' yet' ukwanh nok' ch'ak kalnel silab'il.

Ha pichul lino te wach' ayoch yuj winhaj rey David chi', icha pax chi' yik heb' winh levita b'akhjinak te' kaxa chi' yet' yik heb' winh sb'itani yet' yik winhaj Quenanías skuchb'an heb' winh. Ay pax och jun chaleka nab'a lino yuj winhaj rey David chi'.
Masanil heb' israel ix el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal ayik ix ik'jikot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi', ix puchaj nok' ch'a'ak kalnel yet' trompeta, ix tzinhji platillo, salterio yet' arpa.

Ayik ix jawi te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi' t'a Schonhab' winhaj rey David, haxo ix Mical ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix yisil winhaj Saúl, ix elta t'anhan ix t'a swentena. Ayik ix yilan ix to ha winhaj rey David chi', sk'echennaj winh yuj tzalajk'olal, yuj chi' ix schakel winh ix t'a spensar.
